answer: By the ferrous of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the timber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the thread of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
